title.zh: 对第 9718 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 9718, Entitled: An Act Converting the Naval Institute of Technology in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Biliran Into a State University to Be Known as the Naval State University, Integrating Therewith the Biliran National Agricultural College in the Municipality of Biliran and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 9718, Entitled: An Act Converting the Naval Institute of Technology in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Biliran Into a State University to Be Known as the Naval State University, Integrating Therewith the Biliran National Agricultural College in the Municipality of Biliran and Appropriating Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11170_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
- Section 1. Section 1 of Republic Act No. 9718 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec 1. Renaming of the Naval State University. - The Naval State University in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Biliran is hereby renamed as the Biliran Province State University (BiPSU), hereinafter referred to as the University integrating therewith the Biliran National Agricultural College in the Municipality of Biliran, both located in the Province of Biliran. The main campus of the University shall continue in its present location in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Biliran."

- Section 9 of Republic Act No. 9718 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 9. The University President. - The University President shall be headed by a President, who shall render full-time service. The President, who shall be appointed by the Board, subject to the guidelines qualifications and/or standards set by the Board, upon recommendation of a duly constituted search committee: Provided, That in order to effect a smooth transition, the incumbent OIC President of the Naval State University shall serve as the first and full-fledge and duly appointed President of the University whose term is considered as a transition period for four (4) years.
"x x x."

- Section 10 of Republic Act No. 9718 is hereby amended as follows:
"Sec. 10 Heads of University Campuses. - Campus Directors shall render full-time service. They shall be appointed by the University President, subject to the guidelines, qualifications and standards set by the Board: Provided, That the incumbent college administrators of the extension campuses shall serve as Campus Directors of their respective campuses."

Implementing Rules and Regulations. - The governing Board of the BiPSU, in consultation with the CHED, shall formulate the guidelines to fully implement the provisions of this Act within ninety (90) days from its effectivity.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
